cohort: 673 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who delivered at Shamir Medical Center, Israel (2017-2018)
finding: There is a complex relationship between pregestational weight, gestational weight gain, and GDM, influencing pregnancy outcomes such as SGA and LGA newborns.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were lower among women with insufficient gestational weight gain compared to those with excessive or appropriate weight gain.
